[[File:PoliceDroid-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|A spaceport police droid]]
'''Police droids''' were [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]]<ref name="Police droid">{{SWE|technology|policedroid|police droid}}</ref> that were utilized by various [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] to maintain order and assist flesh-and-blood [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] in their duties. They could be found on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] relied heavily on the [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|Guardian police droids]] to assist in policing the vast stretches of the urbanized planet. [[Spaceport police droid/Legends|Spaceport police droids]] were also common in [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] where there was limited personnel to maintain order or in deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] facilities that maintained only a small crew and had limited life supplies.
